subject: general
question:
Select the figure among the given options that can replace the question mark (?) in the following series.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d347a1a862787e45fec3568341dc76fa3689046dfd1223106c230673baa40779.png]
solution:
The figure that can replace the question mark (?) in the following series is as shown below :

 
• The arrow moves one step in clockwise from figure to figure.
 
• The circle is rotated 90⁰ and moves anti-clockwise from figure to figure.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9a34936d9f9576a676ab44c6063ae307e70c4c487da956a454eb497b16b3a05a.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 4".**
